issue.title: test_mounted_arrival_then_clear_name_keeps_selection loses the selection to message:status in a Master Gate shard, passes on the next SHA and in isolation

task_type_fields.evidence: Master Gate run 38953378752 at docs-only commit 4bd2252f07 (2026-10-16) failed 1 of 7140 in its shard: AssertionError: assert 'u.m@t00' in ('message:status',). The next master SHA ae7f9dc91a went green with no Archive change in between, and the node passed serially on master 97825eee1d. 1 observed failure; root cause unproven.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1lh lander saw this single-node Master Gate red at a docs-only commit while reviewing post-epic master drift; no bead tracks the node.

evidence.note: Landing sase-1lh.7.5.4 observed the same message:status selection failure in Master Gate 39000343130 test(5), SHA 5ea5fa5452. The exact node passed in the 47-node serial integration batch at 28ced2a125 (test and Archive implementation unchanged since the CI SHA); failure/passing environments differ (CI 3.12, local 3.14). No new task or claim of root-cause resolution.
